notes: Shaders are a mod now. The game starts without shaders; turn on the Iris + Sodium Bundle in Mods and you get shaders with MakeUp Ultra Fast included, plus Sodium's video settings. K switches the shaders on and off. If you had shaders before this update, turn the bundle on to get them back.
A brand-new Mods screen: every mod is a card with its own on/off switch, with tabs (All, Enabled, Featured, Client) and search at the top. Click a card to see its page.
